name: crabbox
tagline_zh: 远程跑测试总翻车？CrabBox 一键拉起干净环境，自动检测配置，留下可审计执行证据，连平台覆盖都替你操心。
tagline_en: Remote tests flaky? CrabBox spins clean environments, auto-detects configs, logs auditable runs, and covers.
desc_en: Detect and use Crabbox for repository tests and validation on remote runners. Use when crabbox.yaml or .crabbox.yaml exists, the crabbox CLI is available, or work needs remote compute, a clean or reusable environment, target-platform coverage, or auditable execution evidence.
why_zh: 同类工具要你手动配环境，它却自动读 crabbox.yaml，连执行证据都存好，省心到像雇了个测试助理。
why_en: Unlike manual env setup, it auto-reads crabbox.yaml and archives run evidence—like a QA assistant built-in.
